Generated Narrative: StructureDefinition BeModelDiagnosticReportDiabetes

NameFlagsCard.TypeDescription & Constraints
BeModelDiagnosticReportDiabetes 0..*BaseBeModelDiagnosticReportDiabetes
BeModelDiagnosticReportDiabetes.businessIdentifier 1..*IdentifierBusiness identifier of the report
BeModelDiagnosticReportDiabetes.recordedDate 1..1dateTimeDate of the last update of the report
BeModelDiagnosticReportDiabetes.observationPeriod 1..1PeriodFrom date to date corresponding to the period covered by the report. Typically 14 to 30 days. See business rules
BeModelDiagnosticReportDiabetes.patient 1..1Reference(BePatient)The patient that this report is about
BeModelDiagnosticReportDiabetes.status 1..1codeReport status, by default “Final”. The value is assigned according to the business rule on “% Data Captured”
Binding: BeVSDiabetesReportStatus (required)
BeModelDiagnosticReportDiabetes.recorder 1..1Reference(BePractitioner | BeOrganization)The healthcare professional (INAMI number / national register number) or organization (INAMI approval number / company number) that encodes the information and takes responsibility for its content
BeModelDiagnosticReportDiabetes.interpreter 0..1Reference(BePractitionerRole | BePractitioner)Healthcare provider (INAMI number / national register number) who added an interpretation to the report (e.g. endocrinologist, general practitioner). Not provided by the producer of the report
BeModelDiagnosticReportDiabetes.category 1..*CodeableConceptCategory of the report. At least one category must be assigned
Binding: BeVSDiabetesReportCategory (preferred)
BeModelDiagnosticReportDiabetes.deviceType 0..1CodeableConceptIdentification number assigned by INAMI to the type of sensor model used to create the observations on which the report is based. The individual sensor device is mentioned in the measurement observation
Binding: BeVSDiabetesDeviceType (extensible)
BeModelDiagnosticReportDiabetes.code 1..1CodeableConceptReport code - indicating the type of procedure that leads to the production of the primary values of this report, i.e. 439926003 | Ambulatory continuous glucose monitoring of interstitial tissue fluid
Binding: BeVSDiabetesReportCode (required)
BeModelDiagnosticReportDiabetes.derivedObservations 0..*ObservationList of references to “derived values” type observations (a dozen derived observations) mentioned in the report. These observations are part of the diagnostic report
BeModelDiagnosticReportDiabetes.measuredDiabetesObservations 0..*ObservationReferences to the measured diabetes observations (a few thousand measurements) used to produce the analysis
BeModelDiagnosticReportDiabetes.note 0..*AnnotationReport comments in free text format. Not provided by the producer of the report, but by the healthcare provider doing the interpretation
BeModelDiagnosticReportDiabetes.document 0..*BinaryPDF document containing the complete report (text, graphics, deduced observations, conclusions, etc.)
